label: Backup Service thread count
type: the per-node thread count the Backup Service uses, defaulted from CPU core count (max(1, cpu_cores x 0.75)) and overridable via backup:nodes-threads-map-endpoint. Trades off against memory/resource use elsewhere on the node. Backup-Service-specific setting with no cbbackupmgr CLI equivalent - thread-count tuning is REST-surface-only.
evidence: The default number of threads the Backup Service uses is based on the number of CPU cores in the node.
Reducing the number of threads the Backup Service uses increases the time it takes to backup data.
You change this setting using the `nodesThreadsMap` REST API endpoint.

relates_to_competency_question: What controls how many threads the Backup Service uses per node, and can that be tuned per node?
